encoding: 12-bit height packed into PNG R (high) and the upper nibble of G (low)
source: NASA GSFC PGDA LOLA south-polar DEM (Barker et al. 2023) LDEM_60S_60MPP_ADJ.TIF

north.source: NASA LOLA GDR north-polar shape mosaic LDEM_60N_240M (raw float32)
north.datum: heights above/below the 1737.4 km mean lunar radius
north.validation: grid orientation and scale cross-checked against SLDEM2015 in the 55-60 degN overlap ring: RMS 17 m, bias +0.9 m

global.coverageNote: 90S-60S from LDEM_60S, 60S-60N from SLDEM2015, 60N-90N from LDEM_60N; cross-faded at the boundaries
global.source: SLDEM2015 (LRO LOLA + Kaguya SELENE coregistered) + LDEM_60S polar rows
global.datum: heights above/below the 1737.4 km mean lunar radius

note: Visual relief for the 3D globe; horizon profiles are computed from native-resolution DEM patches instead.
